column8: stricmp.obj's __stricmp under its OLDNAMES spelling: the Libraries' LODFile::Find (0x449e40) calls strcmpi, which LINK binds to this body
fopen.obj and wfopen.obj assemble to the same 19 bytes and differ only in the opener they call; LODFile::open (0x44a080) calls _fopen here
fread.obj and fwrite.obj assemble to the same 47 bytes; this one calls __fread_lk (0x451b7e), and LODFile::open and read (0x44a080, 0x44a270) call _fread here
memcpy.obj and memmove.obj assemble to the same 821 bytes; placed callers of _memmove reach this copy (runtime_error's copy constructor 0x401020, basic_string::erase 0x401a90)
_Xlen and _Xran are the same 90 bytes but for their message; this one throws length_error with "string too long" (0x491590)
_Xran's copy: it throws out_of_range with "invalid string position" (0x4915a0)
